definitions.explanation: knowledge and shrewdness gained through experience in social dealings and worldly affairs

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}けている→長ける：14540_takeru⟧。
examples.english: He is well versed in the ways of the world.

examples.japanese: {世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|つう}じた→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: People who are worldly-wise are good at negotiations.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}けた→長ける：14540_takeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The adults around her were impressed by her worldly-wise conduct despite her young age.

notes:
A literary term for the practical wisdom one gains through social experience and navigating worldly affairs. Often appears in the set phrase {世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}ける→長ける：14540_takeru⟧ (to be experienced in worldly matters). Can carry a slightly negative nuance, suggesting someone is too calculating or shrewd.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}ける→長ける：14540_takeru⟧: to be worldly-wise, to be socially experienced
- {世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧: to be well versed in the ways of the world
- {世故|せこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疎|うと}い→疎い：07842_utoi⟧: to be naive about worldly affairs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世渡|よわた}り→世渡り：07736_yowatari⟧: getting along in the world — more practical, everyday term for navigating life
- ⟦{処世|しょせい}→処世：22542_shosei⟧: conduct in life — formal term for how one handles life's affairs
- {老獪|ろうかい}: cunning/wily — implies shrewd experience with a negative connotation
